{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check the size of the loyal group
print("Number of orders from loyal customers:", len(loyal_df))

# Check the distribution of converted
print("Converted distribution in loyal group:", loyal_df['converted'].value_counts(normalize=True))

# Extract the fraction of converted orders
fraction_converted = loyal_df['converted'].mean()
print(f"Fraction of loyal customers who converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
